content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 12.4).**

§ 12.4 was a one-way covenant on us — 18 months post-termination, covering *any* person employed by Vendor at any time during the term, barring "engage" as well as solicit (an effective no-hire), with no general-advertising carve-out. It also conflicted with § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we made no no-hire commitment.

Redline (fallback, validated ok:true): replaced § 12.4 with a mutual, 12-month, solicitation-only restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, plus carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and express confirmation of no no-hire obligation.
